card.text: Young giant planet about 57 au from its star, between an inner and an outer belt of dust.

sources.label: Desgrange et al. 2022
sources.quote: hosting a giant exoplanet orbiting at 57 au from the star between an inner and outer debris belt

introduction.text: HD 95086 b is a young giant planet with a very red colour. JWST's mid-infrared images rule out a warm disc around the planet as the cause.

sources.label: Desgrange et al. 2022
sources.quote: confirm its very red spectral energy distribution

sources.label: Malin et al. 2024
sources.quote: These observations allow us to refute the hypothesis of a warm circumplanetary disk

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
